description: This Java source file defines the DefaultSqlValidator class, which implements the SqlValidator interface for SQL statement validation within the Apache Fineract project. It initializes validation patterns and profiles from configuration properties, performs consistency checks, and validates SQL statements against configured patterns to prevent unsafe queries.

classes.name: DefaultSqlValidator
classes.description: A class responsible for validating SQL statements based on configurable patterns and profiles, ensuring that only safe SQL statements are executed within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the validator by loading patterns and profiles from properties, performing setup and consistency checks.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates an SQL statement against the default 'main' profile to ensure it does not contain any unsafe patterns.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates an SQL statement against a specified profile, throwing an exception if any pattern matches indicating an unsafe statement.
